@karpathy2024-01-07
			
				
					I’m playing around with calling our tech, as it is today, IA (intelligence amplification) instead of AI. IA have the vibe of tools for thought, needing human interaction, and resemble a lot more what we actually have today. AI feels more like independent long-running agents.
				
			
			
		@simonw
			
				
					It’s OK to call it Artificial Intelligence
I wrote about how people really love objecting to the term "AI" to describe LLMs because they aren't actually "intelligent" - but the term AI has been used to describe this kind of research since 1955 t.co/wgy7lHIdWp
				
			
			
		
Intelligence should be thought as a tool for thought, not an independent agent
These systems should be built on top of human intelligence, not replace it.
Next-token prediction is primitive to call a system intelligent.
Can a transformers ever be Turing-complete?
research area.
A lot of alpha in mechanistic analysis of the representations these models exhibit., or “virtual brain analysis”.
